title: Chardham Yatra
tagline: Four dhams, one sacred circuit — only when the calendar allows it.
overview: Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath, and Badrinath from Haridwar. This is a route template, not a squeezed brochure. A reliable full circuit needs 9–12 days; six days is a two-dham trip.
highlights: All four dhams when duration allows
Kedarnath as a dedicated darshan day, not an attempt
inclusions: Validated day-by-day circuit for your dates
Live hotel stays for each base town
Package confirmation with structured itinerary
exclusions: Flights and trains to Dehradun / Haridwar
Shared taxis and meals (shown as estimates)

notes: Shared taxis / tempo travellers — estimate, not a live transfer booking
Kedarnath helicopter not included unless added

knowBeforeYouGo.title: Government ID
knowBeforeYouGo.body: Carry a government photo ID for hotels and yatra registration. Indian travelers do not need immigration documents for this domestic trip.

knowBeforeYouGo.title: Altitude
knowBeforeYouGo.body: Kedarnath and Badrinath sit above 3,000m. Plan rest after darshan days.

knowBeforeYouGo.title: Road conditions
knowBeforeYouGo.body: Hill roads close for landslides and weather. Keep buffers. Gangotri darshan plus a Guptkashi transfer on the same day is not reliable.

knowBeforeYouGo.title: Temple opening season
knowBeforeYouGo.body: Char Dham temples follow a seasonal opening calendar. Confirm dates for your window before you travel.

knowBeforeYouGo.title: Weather
knowBeforeYouGo.body: Afternoons can turn wet; nights are cold even in summer. Kedarnath is weather-dependent.

knowBeforeYouGo.title: Trekking intensity
knowBeforeYouGo.body: The Kedarnath trek is steep. Helicopter is optional, waitlisted, and not assumed.

knowBeforeYouGo.title: Registration
knowBeforeYouGo.body: Some stretches require biometric / online yatra registration before hill transfers.

knowBeforeYouGo.title: Helicopter
knowBeforeYouGo.body: Kedarnath heli inventory is limited and cancels often. Not included unless you add it.

knowBeforeYouGo.title: Warm clothing
knowBeforeYouGo.body: Layers, rain shell, sturdy shoes. Nights at Barkot, Guptkashi, and Joshimath drop quickly.

knowBeforeYouGo.title: Mobile connectivity
knowBeforeYouGo.body: Coverage is patchy above Uttarkashi and around Kedarnath. Download offline maps.

knowBeforeYouGo.title: Emergency facilities
knowBeforeYouGo.body: Medical posts on the yatra routes are basic. Serious issues mean descend toward Guptkashi, Joshimath, or Dehradun.

title: Goa Long Weekend
tagline: Beach mornings, soft nights, zero overplanning.
overview: A four-day North Goa escape built around one solid stay, a proper beach loop, and one slower Old Goa morning — without stuffing every hour. You get a curated day plan from Itinero; the hotel is quoted and booked live for your dates.
highlights: North Goa beach stretch at your pace
Sunset shack dinner built into Day 1
Live hotel stay you can swap before booking
inclusions: Day-by-day Goa itinerary curated by Itinero
3-night live hotel stay for your selected dates
Suggested beach / Old Goa pacing (no forced group tours)
Hotel swap before you pay
Booking confirmation with itinerary snapshot
exclusions: Meals not listed on your hotel rate
Water sports, boat trips, and entry tickets
goodToKnow: From-price is a marketing floor for the package lane — live hotel totals change with dates, occupancy, and hotel choice.
Christmas / NYE weekends sell out early; book the stay as soon as dates are firm.
Keep one afternoon empty — Goa works better with slack than a packed checklist.
Best weather window is roughly November–March; monsoon months are greener but wetter.
